toegepas.rede_vinder: The second clause contrasts with the first (practised, yet not chosen), so 'maar' carries the link more naturally than 'en'.
toegepas.fout: 'en' joins two clauses that contrast (a week of practice, yet not chosen), so the link is flat.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'maar' states the contrast the sentence already means, with the same people, actions and order, and the AWS comma stays.

toegepas.blok: Wat jy met 'n groot gevoel kan doen
toegepas.na: Vertel vir iemand hoe jy voel.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'dit' has no clear antecedent at the start of a new list item; naming what is told removes the vague reference without adding content.
toegepas.fout: 'dit' opens a list item that is read on its own and has no clear antecedent.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming what is told ('hoe jy voel') removes the vague reference without adding a person, fact or step, and the item is a coping strategy, not a safety instruction.

toegepas.blok: Voel vir hom en wil help
toegepas.na: As jy deernis het, voel jy
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'By deernis' is a stiff, unidiomatic opener; 'As jy deernis het' says the same thing naturally for Grade 5.
toegepas.fout: 'By deernis voel jy' is a stiff, unidiomatic opener for a Grade 5 reader.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'As jy deernis het' says the same thing naturally and keeps the protected word 'deernis' intact.

laat_vaar.voor: niemand van hulle doen dit verkeerd nie
laat_vaar.na: nie een van hulle doen dit verkeerd nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: With a counted group ('al drie'), 'nie een van hulle' is the more natural Afrikaans than 'niemand van hulle'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'niemand van hulle' is natural Afrikaans here, so the swap is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.blok: Voel vir hom en wil help
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'deel' reads incomplete without saying with whom; 'met hom' matches 'langs hom' earlier in the sentence.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'jou kospakkie deel' is complete in context, and 'met hom' adds a third 'hom' to a sentence that already has two.

laat_vaar.voor: soos brood deel en saam huis toe loop
laat_vaar.na: soos om brood te deel en saam huis toe te loop
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: After 'dinge soos' the activities read better as infinitive phrases with 'om ... te' than as bare verb strings.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Bare verb phrases after 'soos' are natural Afrikaans, and the 'om ... te' form only makes the sentence longer.

na_skrywer.voor: Verstaan en saamvoel deur jou in iemand anders se plek in te dink.
na_skrywer.na: Om te verstaan en saam te voel deur jou in iemand anders se plek in te dink.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: A definition starting with bare verbs reads as an order; the 'Om te' form matches the 'deernis' entry and reads as a definition.
na_skrywer.fout: The definition opens with bare verbs, unlike the 'Om ...' shape of the deernis entry.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This rewords a glossary definition that is shared across lessons, so only the writer may change it, for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: Om vir iemand wat swaarkry te voel
na_skrywer.na: Om vir iemand wat swaarkry, te voel
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: A comma after an embedded relative clause before the verb aids reading and matches 'waarop jy gehoop het, nie gebeur nie' elsewhere in the lesson.
na_skrywer.fout: Without a comma, the verbs 'swaarkry te voel' run together and can make a reader stumble, unlike the lesson's own 'gehoop het, nie gebeur nie'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The comma may help, but this definition is shared word for word across lessons, so the writer must decide it for all of them at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.blok: Wat jy met 'n groot gevoel kan doen
vlae.teks: Noem die gevoel by sy naam en sê vir jouself jy is kwaad.
vlae.rede: The block is about any big feeling, but the example names only anger; making it general (e.g. 'sê vir jouself hoe jy voel') would change the content, so it is left for the reviewer or writer.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Hartseer wys nie by almal op dieselfde manier nie.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Hartseer lyk nie by almal dieselfde nie.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Intransitive 'wys' here follows English 'shows'; 'lyk nie by almal dieselfde nie' is more natural and shorter.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'lyk' narrows the sense to appearance, while the paragraph describes behaviour (crying, going quiet, getting angry), and the original reads naturally.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Wat jy met 'n groot gevoel kan doen
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The disappointment is their own; the possessive reads more naturally than the definite article.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Afrikaans naturally uses the definite article where English uses a possessive, so 'die teleurstelling' already reads well and the swap is lateral.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Hy kan wel bly waar sy maat is.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Hy kan wel by sy maat bly.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'bly waar sy maat is' is wooden; 'by sy maat bly' is the natural phrase, keeps the meaning and matches 'Bly by jou maat' later in the lesson.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'by sy maat bly' can also mean staying over at or living with the friend, while 'bly waar sy maat is' says only that he stays present, so the preposition change moves the meaning.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Dit kan die grootmens by die huis wees
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Dit kan 'n grootmens by die huis wees
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The three options are parallel ('n onderwyser, 'n verpleegster), so the indefinite article fits; 'die grootmens' suggests one specific person.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'die grootmens by die huis' naturally means the child's own caregiver and reads well; changing it alters who to tell in a safety instruction for the sake of parallelism only.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The intended meaning is that the feeling makes you want to push back ('laat wil'); 'wil laat' says the feeling wants to make you.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'dit wil jou laat terugstoot' is idiomatic Afrikaans ('wil' meaning 'tends to'), so this is no grammar error, and the definition is shared wording.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'seermaak' needs an object here, as in the study text ('wanneer iets jou seermaak').
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Intransitive 'iets maak seer' is standard Afrikaans, so this glossary definition has no grammar fault to fix.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Voel vir hom en wil help
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'nie noodwendig' is the natural Afrikaans for 'does not necessarily mean'; 'nie vanself' reads oddly here.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Nie vanself nie' (not automatically) is natural Afrikaans and plainer for Grade 5, so swapping in 'noodwendig' is a lateral move that shifts the nuance slightly.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'vra' has no object here, so it is unclear what is asked; 'gaan na die volgende een' keeps the meaning of turning to the next adult.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Gaan vra die volgende een' is natural, clear Afrikaans in context, and 'gaan na' changes a safety instruction from asking an adult to merely going to one.
